description: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. Own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market which includes target-accounts and an existing book of business that has companies with 3000+ employees. Primary focus is on hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the ENT sector. Upscaling existing account base through expansion and upsell, leveraging our Extended Access Management Identity. How we’re using AI today Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here. Expectations of this role This is a field-based sales role. That means you are expected to be regularly engaged in customer-facing activities, including in-person meetings, events, and other travel as required to effectively support your territory. Your primary work location will be your home office, but your role requires a lot of mobility and flexibility. Travel within your assigned territory, and occasionally outside of it, will be a part of your job, and you are responsible for managing your schedule in a way that works for the company and you. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. What we're looking for: You can communicate in English and German fluently 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on Enterprise accounts OR top performance in MidMarket/Commercial and ready to step up. Familiarity with the DACH region. Demonstrated success in owning and growing a geographical territory or country within the DACH region. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs. Outstanding sales skills in prospecting, pipeline building, strategic account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with meticulous operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target Demonstrated success in upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business, and in uncovering customer pain points beyond what's initially shared Proficient skills in business acumen, negotiation, relationship building, communication & presentation skills to C-Suite Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management. Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently in a remote setting. Preferable proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, Linkedin Sales Navigator & Outreach Please note that this job description is subject to modifications and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities. What you can expect: Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new ENT clients and expanding existing accounts. Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting (cold calling, and networking), supplemented with inbound leads and effective pipeline development inline with our sales methodology. Drive New Business Growth: Key Activities for effective sales strategies to meet and exceed sales targets including: Strategic Territory Segmentation: Refine client targeting by segmenting against Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) that align with enterprise needs and priorities. Contextual Business Understanding & Multithreading: Develop deep insights into the enterprise's structure, key decision-makers, and buying processes. Implement multithreading to engage various stakeholders across departments, ensuring broad influence and deeper engagement. Excellence in Outbound & Pipeline Generation: Leverage a combination of self-generated outreach, BDR collaboration, and marketing-driven initiatives to consistently build a high-quality pipeline. Tailored Discovery & Scoping: Align 1Password’s value to the enterprise's unique challenges through comprehensive discovery and scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are relevant and impactful at scale. Continuous Improvement via Coaching: Maintain a growth mindset by actively participating in high-quality coaching sessions, driving incremental improvements in sales performance weekly Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to expand and cross-sell 1Password’s solutions within existing accounts by building key stakeholder relationships and leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management. Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence and build relationships with potential customers Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to provide valuable insights to clients and position 1Password as an industry leader. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Internal Collaboration: Foster strong partnerships with internal teams such as BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, and Customer Success to craft tailored solutions that address the complex needs of enterprise clients, ensuring alignment across the customer journey. Multithreaded Client Engagement: Develop and maintain relationships across multiple stakeholders within enterprise client organizations, including C-level, IT, and security teams. This approach ensures a comprehensive understanding of the client's business, enhancing account health and expanding long-term value. Focus on Solution-Driven Selling: Implement 1Password methodology to ensure our solutions are strategically aligned with client goals and tailored to their specific needs. Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of client challenges, and position our offerings as impactful, customized solutions that drive value and outcomes. Present and Negotiate: Confidently present to executives, articulating the value proposition of our products and services. Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals. Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes. At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Our culture At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results. How we work with AI We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password. This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. Our approach to work We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. Some roles are designated as remote-first, with an expectation that individuals work from their homes majority of the time, while others are designated as in-office roles, with an expectation of being on-site on a regular basis. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement. For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. These events are typically held in varying locations across Canada, USA and/or EMEA. In leadership roles, you can expect to travel once per month on average. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto. description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.  

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join our London based team and work directly with sports organisations across the UK. You’ll primarily focus on the amateur and grassroots football market. As a Sales team, our goal is to understand our clients' pain points and help them make the most of our solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious professional to focus on sourcing and signing new customers.

For this role, we're currently considering candidates who live within a commuting distance of our office in London. You will be required to attend the office a minimum of 3 days a week. 

Must-Haves

  • Experience. You have some experience in a customer-facing sales role.
  • Motivation. You love to beat your own records, expect the best from yourself, and want to keep improving.
  • The Dealmaker: A relentless closer with high-velocity drive, using creative negotiation to convert a steady mix of inbound and outbound leads into done deals.
  • Organisational skills. You own your territory by mapping out your days with the prospects you’re going to contact.
  • Passion for sport and technology. You can’t wait to bring the best sports software in the world to teams across the UK.
  • Communication skills. You build relationships and network naturally. You’re not afraid to call the decision-makers and close a sale. You love to talk to people, whether it’s in person, on the phone or over video calls. 
  • Innovation. You proactively plan and reimagine how to help customers.
  • Teamwork. Collaboration is key to our success at Hudl. While you're adept at working independently, you also thrive in a team environment. You understand the importance of leveraging collective strengths and supporting your colleagues to achieve shared goals.
  • Travel. You’re happy to hit the road and visit customers on a consistent basis, as often as a few times a month.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Sports background. Previous experience in the sporting environment, particularly football is strongly preferred.
  • Additional sales experience. You understand SaaS sales methodologies and consulting methodologies, know why we always put the customer first, and strive to generate revenue by excelling at technical pre-sales and solution consulting.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range and on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are displayed below. Typically, the total compensation will fall within the middle of the OTE band.

Our compensation decisions are based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Final compensation will depend on your performance against quotas outlined in your Individual Sales Plan (ISP) upon hire.

Base Salary Range
£24,300—£40,500 GBP
On-Target Earnings
£40,500—£67,500 GBP

Inclusion at Hudl 

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong. 

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports. 

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve

Cognite operates at the forefront of industrial digitalization, building AI, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.


 

How you’ll demonstrate Ownership

As the Sales Account Executive, you will engage with prospects to win business from large companies in the Life Sciences/Pharma verticals. . You will help customers achieve improved business results through their adoption of Cognite Data Fusion to accelerate their digital transformations.

  • Achieve bookings targets while developing satisfied and reference-able customers
  • Develop and execute a territory strategy to drive bookings growth and win new customers
  • Through active prospecting and your personal network of contacts, generate new pipeline and provide “commercial insights” to prospective clients on how Cognite’s solutions will address the most important areas of their value chain
  • Manage complex sales cycles and lead your extended territory team (pre-sales and other key functions) to delight your prospects and customers
  • Utilize value-selling processes alongside demonstrating a wealth of knowledge of Cognite’s solutions and how they impact our customer’s value realization
  • Negotiate favorable pricing and business terms with large enterprises by selling value and ROI
  • Develop a commanding knowledge of Cognite’s solutions and how they uniquely drive value realization with your customers
  • Accurately forecast monthly and quarterly results
  • Update salesforce.com on a regular basis
  • Provide timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions, particularly product management and marketing
  • Present and demonstrate our solutions in-person and via web-based presentations
  • Approximately 50% travel on client site and to our European offices
  • Develop a commanding knowledge of Cognite’s solutions and how they uniquely drive value realization with your customers

The Impact you bring to Cognite

  • Detail oriented, high-energy sales professional with strong relationship-building skills and a focus on delighting customers in every phase of our engagements
  • Proven experience selling at C-Level both in business and IT
  • Specific experience in selling SaaS solutions, cloud deployments  and subscription pricing model, commanding a deep understanding of software sales processes and terminology including ARR, NRR, TCV and Services Bookings
  • Self-starter, able to work in a team environment, and superb time management and prioritization skills
  • Excellent communication skills, including stellar presentation skills
  • Has demonstrated a dedication to driving standardization to sales processes to ensure consistent and scalable results
  • Committed to value based selling and is savvy at helping customers create business cases with quantified ROI to justify new investments
  • Can explain the respective value chains for process and discrete manufacturing - including the key economic drivers; the business, people, and technical inter-dependencies; the digitalization opportunity with Industry 4.0
  • Well-versed in important manufacturing use cases, such as yield optimization, production visibility, higher operator productivity, quality improvement, predictive maintenance, and higher machine utilization
  • Familiarity with relevant technology, such as Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Hive, BigQuery); Data Warehouses; Business Intelligence; and Machine Learning

Required Qualifications and Preferred Experiences 

  • 3+ years successful Software Sales Experience into Life Sciences/Pharma companies is required (Pharma, Bio-Pharma and Contract Manufacturing, Medical Devices and Medical Products)
  • 3+ years of direct sales experience carrying and exceeding a quota and selling enterprise software/ software-as-a-service (Business Intelligence/ Data Warehouse/ Big Data/ Advanced Analytics/ Machine Learning/Automation/Operational Technology) to C-level executives
  • Previous training in Command of the Message, MEDDPICC and Salesforce is a plus, but not a requirement.
  • Minimum Bachelor’s degree. A relevant Master’s degree is preferred.
 
 
 
Learn more about us
 
 
 
  • Impact 2025
  • Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
  • We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.
 
 
Equal Opportunity
Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.

Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Descriptif du poste :

En tant que Account Manager – Paris, vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes stratégiques, afin de mettre en place les outils les plus pertinents pour nos utilisateurs. Vous reporterez directement au Client Partner en place.

Vos principales missions :

  • Gérer un portefeuille de restaurants clés dans des secteurs matures, nécessitant une réelle expertise et une attention particulière.

  • Créer un partenariat privilégié et durable en apportant votre expertise Food Tech, en tant qu’expert(e) de votre zone/ville.

  • Optimiser la rentabilité de votre portefeuille et proposer un accompagnement personnalisé, construit sur le long terme avec l’appui de la data.

  • Soyez un expert de votre zone et assurer le rayonnement de Deliveroo grâce à une vision 360 : account management, sales, marketing, opérations.

  • Analyser la performance de votre portefeuille et prendre les mesures adéquates. Faire des recommandations directes au Client Partner, faire preuve d’agilité et d’ouverture à la nouveauté. Deliveroo est une entreprise en mouvement, avec des outils et options à déployer à un rythme soutenu.

  • Suggérer et mettre en œuvre des campagnes marketing et promotionnelles adaptées à votre portefeuille.

  • Suivre de près les opérations pour optimiser l’expérience à la fois des restaurants partenaires et des clients.

Votre expérience et vos qualités :

  • 2 à 3 ans d’expérience minimum sur un poste similaire.

  • Capacité à négocier, anticiper des discussions commerciales, entreprendre les actions nécessaires pour maintenir un portefeuille de qualité (discussions contractuelles, négociation d’outils commerciaux, etc.) et atteindre les objectifs (OKRs).

  • Capacités d’analyse data afin d’y tirer des axes de croissance nécessaires au développement de vos comptes.

  • Capacité à garder le contrôle de son portefeuille Partenaires, à observer les tendances du marché et à fournir des retours en temps réel à ses partenaires et à son manager.

  • Expertise terrain : proche de vos partenaires, vous êtes capable d’assurer une veille concurrentielle qualitative sur votre portefeuille et votre secteur.

  • Capacité à convaincre et à influencer vos partenaires pour atteindre les objectifs fixés, tout en respectant les valeurs de Deliveroo.

  • Proactivité et capacité à tirer des conclusions des résultats de vos actions pour faire des recommandations pertinentes aux partenaires.

  • Compréhension et appropriation rapide des objectifs à atteindre, avec autonomie et détermination.

  • Capacité à mettre en place des actions personnalisées et cohérentes avec les besoins des partenaires et les directives managériales.

  • Capacité à identifier, comprendre et analyser les données de performance commerciale et opérationnelle sur l’ensemble de votre portefeuille dans une logique d’excellence de service.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit/parlé) pour défendre un point de vue et communiquer efficacement.

  • Capacité à construire des relations commerciales durables afin de faire de Deliveroo la référence de la “food” aux yeux de nos partenaires.

Environnement de travail & avantages

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être. Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays. Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.

Diversité

Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!

À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission de transformer la façon dont les gens commandent et apprécient leurs repas. Chez Deliveroo, notre équipe Brand & Experience crée des expériences engageantes qui renforcent le lien entre notre marque et nos clients, partenaires et livreurs.

Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Fidélisation en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Fidélisation, vous contribuerez au développement de Deliveroo Plus, notre programme d'abonnement, en participant au déploiement de campagnes marketing et en accompagnant des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos clients.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Au sein de l'équipe Fidélisation, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Marketing Managers ainsi qu'avec les équipes CRM, Brand, Media, Creative, les équipes commerciales et nos partenaires stratégiques.

Au quotidien, vous serez amené·e à :

  • Coordonner la création des campagnes Deliveroo Plus en rédigeant et en pilotant les briefs CRM, créatifs et juridiques avec les équipes locales, globales et les agences.

  • Adapter et localiser les campagnes marketing internationales pour le marché français en garantissant leur cohérence avec notre identité de marque.

  • Assurer le suivi des performances des offres Deliveroo Plus et contribuer à l'identification des opportunités d'optimisation.

  • Préparer les reportings hebdomadaires et mensuels destinés à nos partenaires stratégiques.

  • Participer aux lancements de campagnes marketing 360° (CRM, digital, TV, influence, événementiel et in-app) en coordonnant les différentes parties prenantes.

  • Réaliser une veille concurrentielle sur les programmes de fidélisation et partager des recommandations pour enrichir notre stratégie.

 

Ce qui vous permettra de réussir

Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les points suivants :

  • Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle.

  • Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais.

  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations.

  • Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs.

  • Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Deliveroo ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets concrets ayant un impact direct sur des millions de clients.

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous bénéficierez :

  • D'un accompagnement tout au long de votre alternance par des experts du marketing.

  • D'une forte exposition à des projets stratégiques et à des équipes internationales.

  • D'un environnement collaboratif où l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'apprentissage sont encouragés.

  • D'une expérience au sein d'une entreprise technologique internationale en constante évolution.

 

Notre processus de recrutement

Notre objectif est de vous permettre de montrer votre potentiel dans les meilleures conditions.

Le processus comprend généralement :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition.

  • Un entretien avec le manager de l'équipe Fidélisation pour échanger sur vos motivations, votre façon de travailler et découvrir davantage l'équipe.

Construire un environnement où chacun a sa place

Chez Deliveroo, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes fait notre force. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, quelles que soient l'origine, le genre, l'âge, le handicap, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité de genre, les convictions ou le parcours.

Si vous avez besoin d'un aménagement particulier durant le processus de recrutement, n'hésitez pas à nous en faire part.

Prêt·e à rejoindre l'aventure Deliveroo ? Nous avons hâte de vous rencontrer.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. Working across high-profile collaborations including GSK and Novartis, you will be the connective tissue between Relation and our partners - building trusted relationships, creating clarity across complex collaborations and helping both organisations work together effectively towards shared strategic goals. You will sit at the centre of Relation’s partnership model, working closely with Programme Leaders, interdisciplinary teams and senior leaders across Relation and our partner organisations. You will have a highly visible role to safeguard relationship health, contractual alignment and forward visibility - ensuring that the right conversations happen at the right time, commitments are clearly understood, risks and opportunities are surfaced early, and that governance enables high-quality decision making at pace. The delivery of successful partnerships strengthen both partner organisations, and ultimately help to fulfill Relation’s goal of bringing transformational medicines to patients. Day to day you will: Manage the health and effectiveness of strategic pharma partnerships, building trusted relationships across Relation and partner organisations and influencing cross-functional stakeholders at all levels to maintain alignment and momentum. Shape and steward partnership governance, ensuring governance meetings focus on the decisions, risks and opportunities that matter, with clear ownership, effective escalation and disciplined follow-through. Maintain forward visibility across each alliance, anticipating relational, contractual and governance risks and opportunities and ensuring they are surfaced early to the appropriate decision-makers. Safeguard contractual alignment, maintaining oversight of scope, milestones, reporting requirements, financial triggers, data-sharing commitments and other obligations; translating contractual terms into clear implications for teams and governance. Influence across organisational boundaries, connecting Programme Leaders, interdisciplinary teams, senior leadership and partner stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, navigate competing perspectives and enable timely decisions. Lead alliance-level escalation, bringing clarity to complex or sensitive issues and ensuring escalation strengthens decision-making. Shape new partnerships from diligence through launch, collaborating closely with Growth, Corporate and Business Development to embed effective governance, contractual clarity and practical ways of working from the outset. Raise the standard of partnering at Relation, applying learning across collaborations to strengthen governance, alliance management and organisational partnering capability as Relation’s portfolio grows. Professionally, you will have: A university degree in a relevant scientific or technical field, or equivalent experience. Significant experience in alliance management or strategic partnerships within biotech or pharmaceutical R&D, including substantial experience working with large pharmaceutical partners. Deep expertise working with complex collaboration agreements, with the judgement to interpret contractual commitments, identify implications and risks, and translate them into clear actions or governance decisions. Experience working in data-rich, technology-enabled or AI/ML-enabled R&D environments is key, particularly in partnerships involving contractual alignment at the intersection of data, technology and intellectual property. Strong scientific and drug discovery fluency, enabling you to operate credibly with senior scientific leaders and interdisciplinary teams. A track record of influencing senior stakeholders without formal authority, navigating organisational complexity and building alignment across companies, disciplines and competing priorities. Strong governance judgement, with experience bringing complex scientific, commercial, contractual and relational issues to senior decision-making forums. Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior leaders and external partners. Confidence navigating disagreement, ambiguity and sensitive partner issues with diplomacy, sound judgement and integrity. The ability to maintain strategic perspective and forward visibility while overseeing multiple complex partnerships in a fast-moving environment. Bonus experience: Professional alliance management accreditation, such as ASAP CA-AM or CSAP, is desirable. Personally, you: Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams. Take ownership of your work, proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work. Communicate openly and directly, give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect. Actively seek out diverse perspectives, build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams. Embrace challenges with openness and resilience, set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working Style & Culture at Relation At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment, where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. We collaborate, and you will partner with colleagues across multiple teams and projects, contributing your expertise while aligning to shared company priorities. We work together and win together! 3186 - Associate Director, Applied Analytics - UK

The Analytics Associate Director, Tesco will play a pivotal role in the dedicated analytics team supporting the Tesco account.

Crucially, the Associate Director will champion the use of Tesco's rich first-party transactional and loyalty data to design, implement, and analyse rigorous test-and-learn frameworks (including matched-market testing and randomized control trials) to prove the incremental impact of marketing activity. This role requires a blend of hands-on analytical expertise, retail commercial acumen, client engagement, and mentorship of junior team members.

Client Leadership:

  • Analytical Partnership: Act as the key analytical partner for Tesco, translating commercial and marketing briefs into actionable, data-driven measurement methodologies.
  • Strategic Advisory: Lead dialogues with senior Tesco marketing stakeholders and internal agency planning teams, leveraging expert knowledge of retail trends, consumer behavior, and marketing effectiveness.
  • Effectiveness Integration: Ensure that measurement, incremental testing, and business KPIs are integrated as core considerations at all stages of the media planning cycle, from strategy development through to activation.

Strategic Measurement & First-Party Data Delivery:

  • Closed-Loop & Incremental Testing: Lead the design, implementation, and analysis of marketing tests (e.g., A/B testing, geo-matched market tests, and randomized control trials) leveraging Tesco’s first-party transactional and Clubcard data to isolate the true incremental lift of media channels.
  • Measurement Frameworks: Lead the development of comprehensive campaign measurement and KPI frameworks, defining clear definitions of commercial success (such as ROI, CPA, brand health, and customer lifetime value).
  • Methodology Recommendation: Recommend the most appropriate suite of measurement methodologies, combining predictive modeling (e.g., MMM), digital attribution, and first-party loyalty data matching.
  • Measurement Audits: Conduct regular audits of Tesco's measurement capabilities, prioritising and recommending improvements to data pipelines and test-and-learn setups.
  • Insight Narrative: Take ownership of learning agendas, distilling the complexity of multiple data sources and test results into highly commercial, executive-friendly narratives that identify what drove sales, what built brand equity, and how to optimise future budgets.

Commercial Growth & Innovation:

  • First-Party Data Innovation: Proactively identify and explore innovative ways to leverage first-party datasets, retail media clean rooms (e.g., InfoSum, Habu), and retailer-loop feedback to enhance campaign effectiveness.
  • Business Case Development: Contribute to building business cases for incremental investment in advanced effectiveness tools and bespoke data science solutions.
  • Industry Representation: Stay at the forefront of retail media, privacy-first measurement, and industry best practices.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Mentorship: Manage, mentor, and inspire junior team members on a day-to-day basis, fostering their technical skills and commercial consulting abilities.
  • Thought Leadership: Contribute to thought leadership promoting excellence in retail analytics, first-party data activation, and privacy-safe measurement within WPP Media and the wider industry.

Skills and Experience

  • Educational Background: Strong analytical background, typically with a Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a business/marketing equivalent with strong quantitative modules).
  • Proven Experience: Experience in marketing effectiveness, media measurement, and advanced analytics, preferably with exposure to retail, FMCG, or subscription-based businesses.
  • Test Design Expertise: Proven experience designing, executing, and evaluating matched-market testing, A/B testing, and regional media test-and-learn frameworks.
  • First-Party Data Literacy: Experience working with large-scale first-party datasets, CRM/loyalty data (such as Clubcard/Dunnhumby), or Retail Media Networks is highly advantageous.
  • Measurement Toolkit: Deep knowledge of marketing mix modelling (MMM), digital attribution, brand lift studies, and data clean room technologies.
  • Technical & Tool Proficiency:
    • Advanced Excel skills for data manipulation and analysis are required.
    • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI) is highly desirable.
    • Experience with industry planning and tracking tools (e.g., YouGov, TGI, IPA Touchpoints) is preferred but secondary to data/analytics capabilities.
  • Retail & Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of retail economics, online-to-offline customer journeys, and commercial drivers.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex statistical methodologies and data points into clear, commercial, and compelling narratives for senior retail stakeholders.
  • Data Privacy: Strong understanding of UK data governance, GDPR compliance, and privacy-safe data sharing practices (especially concerning first-party customer matching).

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Role overview We are looking for a talented and commercially minded Chief of Staff to report directly to the CRO. The CRO owns Checkout.com's global revenue organisation (Sales, Account Management, Partnerships, Solutions Engineering, Revenue Operations and Pricing) across all regions. As the CRO's right hand, you will extend their reach, speed up decision-making, and make sure the Commercial leadership team is aligned and delivering against its revenue targets. This is not a back-office role. You will act as the CRO's delegate on key approvals, work on live deals and pricing decisions, resolve the cross-functional blockers that slow down revenue, and contribute to the planning and operating rhythm of a global commercial organisation. You'll be a trusted advisor and sounding board to the CRO and their leadership team. You'll be expected to challenge them, not just support them, and to move comfortably from a board-level narrative to a merchant pricing decision on the same day. Remit and Responsibilities As a thought partner and sounding board to the CRO, pressure-test ideas, bring an independent point of view, and turn strategy into clear, owned actions. Represent the CRO in internal forums and make decisions on their behalf when needed, including during absences. Work with revenue leaders on deal strategy for our largest new and existing merchants, and set up executive engagement to open or speed up opportunities. Stay close to the global pipeline and forecast, hold revenue leaders accountable for their numbers, inputs and follow-ups, and flag risks and opportunities early. Own the CRO's leadership cadence (leadership team meetings, business reviews and decision forums), making sure each one has a clear purpose, clear decisions and accountable owners. Act as the CRO's delegate for key approvals across the Commercial organisation, including pricing, offers and job requisitions. Apply agreed frameworks consistently, challenge where needed, and know when to escalate. Partner with Revenue Operations and Finance on annual and quarterly planning, including targets, headcount and capacity planning, budgets and OKRs. Drive the governance and prioritisation of the Commercial-wide hiring plan, partnering with Revenue Operations on capacity planning and with Talent Acquisition, People and Finance to keep hiring aligned with revenue priorities and budget as we scale. Design and run the Commercial Leadership Summit and other leadership offsites, from agenda and content through to follow-up and accountability. Be part of the Commercial organisation's main link to Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Marketing and People leadership. Pick up the issues the Commercial team faces day to day, frame them clearly, get the right people in the room and push for a decision, especially where senior leaders are not yet aligned. Work with Operations, Legal and Compliance on initiatives to reduce time to revenue for new merchants. Own high-priority strategic initiatives from start to finish, usually with a clear revenue or efficiency target and several teams involved. Keep challenging how the Commercial organisation works, and simplify processes, governance and tools to increase productivity, including through AI and automation. Prepare the CRO for all key meetings and presentations, including exec and board meetings, All-hands meetings, business reviews, customer meetings and external speaking engagements. This covers pre-reads, briefings, presentations, speaker notes and follow-ups. Desired Background, Core Competencies You have 5+ years of experience in roles such as Chief of Staff, strategy consulting, commercial or revenue strategy, or business management, ideally including time in a high-growth tech, fintech or payments company. Strong commercial instinct: you understand how revenue is built through pipeline, pricing, unit economics and forecasting, and you're comfortable getting into the details of a deal. Sound judgement to exercise delegated authority on approvals, balancing commercial speed with discipline and knowing when to escalate. A proven track record of influencing senior leaders without formal authority, including handling disagreement between them and getting to a clear outcome. Excellent structured thinking and communication: you can reduce complex, ambiguous problems to a clear recommendation and write in a way that's ready for executives. Critical thinker who is confident with data and financial models and uses them to support decisions. Excellent project and programme management skills, with the ability to switch contexts without losing focus. Discretion when handling confidential people, commercial and financial information. A low-ego, high-ownership mindset: you're as comfortable doing the work yourself as you are orchestrating others. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Data Strategy Manager - UK

EssenceMediacom is seeking a Data Strategy Manager to join our growing Data, Technology & Analytics team, reporting into the Data, Tech & Analytics Lead. The team focuses on maximising the value and impact of all data types on a client’s business, and how we effectively measure the performance to help make brands become more valuable to the world.

You will be working with one of the leading retailers in the UK, Boots, to harness their data and improve the performance of their campaigns, developing and deploying media measurement solutions. Communication with client stakeholders and effective management of assigned tasks is critical in this role. You will be joining a team which has doubled in resource over the past 12 months, with an ever-expanding remit to put data at the heart of the marketing function.

Part of The Boots Group, Boots is the UKs authority in beauty, wellness and healthcare with 176 years of trusted heritage and innovation behind it. Boots consistently delivers strong retail and pharmacy sales quarter after quarter in a hugely competitive market.  Boots are hungry to keep striving and prioritise great teamwork and true partnership with their agencies to achieve their ambitions.

They are a client who embrace change, encourage innovation, are leaders in data-led planning to fully understand the impact of media in the wider business system and always make time to appreciate achievements and say thank you.  They challenge us to deliver world class media planning and activation and enjoy getting recognition for great work we achieve together.

Responsible for transforming data into actionable insights that drive superior client outcomes. Data Strategy involves transforming the way our clients think about, organize and orchestrate data & technology to deliver more timely, engaging and meaningful brand experience for their customers. Boots is a data rich client and that combined with clients willingness to test and evolve makes for opportunities to do great work. The Project Lead will optimise audience-driven strategies, identify growth opportunities, and deliver measurable business impact.

Data-led audience & bidding strategy and enablement;

  • Data Partnerships: oversee strategic partnerships, ensuring their data is fully integrated and leveraged within our platforms to deliver maximum value for the client.
  • Agentic AI: guiding the wider DTA team on what personas and agents need to be built to deliver valuable insights for the clients.

Cross-functional Collaboration;

  • Work closely with stakeholders to identify and deliver on technology opportunities that drive growth and optimise outcomes for the clients business. This includes our internal MarTech team and the CRM team at Boots
  • Foster collaboration between technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment on project goals and client objectives.

Co-own Boots Data Strategy testing workstream;

  • Work with internal testing leads and activation teams to bring forward robust testing methodologies for Data & Tech focused tests.
  • Produce collateral for client facing case studies and share more widely with the business.

Data Governance and Compliance

  • Updating any partner changes and reflecting this in internal documents and with client.

  • Digital working agency-side working on a data-led role within Data & Tech or Activation, with a strong emphasis on audience-based buying, audience data management and segmentation.
  • Highly developed interpersonal, team building and relationship management skills
  • Strong analytical skills and a natural affinity for numbers is key; You must be able to analyse raw data, draw conclusions and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Understanding of the importance of privacy first media and what that means for how we need to do things differently

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Role

As Head of Global Accounts, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for the commercial relationship with France's most strategic restaurant brands. Your team currently consists of 7 people: Key Account Managers who own brand HQ relationships, and a Client Partner (mid-manager) who manages a team of Key Account Associates covering franchisees across the territory. You report to the Director of Enterprise & Key Accounts, France, and are based in Paris (this is a hybrid role). You are the senior commercial owner for your portfolio — accountable for revenue growth, partner satisfaction, and team excellence. Beyond day-to-day account management, you will play a central role in aligning the organisation to strategic priorities: from contract structuring and joint business planning, to supporting Deliveroo's city expansion strategy by securing anchor restaurant partners in new and relaunching markets. This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence
    • Own the end-to-end commercial growth of Global Accounts in France Lead contract negotiations, renewals, and upsell strategies with major restaurant brands 
    • Build and execute joint business plans covering partner growth, profitability, and operational performance
    • Drive co-investment marketing strategy with partners, including co-funded campaigns and promotional activations
  2. Support Deliveroo’s expansion strategy:
    • Secure anchor brand commitments in new cities and relaunching markets
    • Act as a trusted C-level advisor, providing insight on Deliveroo's capabilities, competitive landscape, and market trends
    • Build and maintain senior and C-suite stakeholder relationships across France's most strategic brands
    • Set and maintain 5★ account management standards across the team, with clear portfolio sizing and coverage 
  3. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance teams Represent the French perspective in international Global Accounts forums Influence product roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback
  4. People & Organisational Development Lead, coach, and develop a team of 7 people — directly and through mid-management Build a strong internal succession pipeline by identifying and developing high-potential talent Define and continuously evolve the organisational model (coverage, seniority structure, processes) as the business scales

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles — with a track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder brand portfolios
  • Demonstrated ability to structure and close complex commercial agreements with brand or franchise HQs (contract negotiation is essential)
  • Strong KPI ownership: comfortable defining, owning, and reporting on revenue and performance metrics with a structured, data-driven approach
  • Experience leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Strong financial acumen and P&L literacy English fluency Nice-to-Have Familiarity with franchised or multi-site restaurant networks
  • Experience in a marketplace, F&B, Hospitality, Retail, or FMCG environment Leadership Profile Senior, credible, and resilient — able to build trust and influence at C-suite level
  • High ownership mindset with a strong bias for action
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving organisational change
  • Passionate about developing talent and raising team standards
  • Collaborative leader who builds strong cross-functional partnerships and fosters an inclusive, high-performing culture.

Recruitment Process Business Interview Business case presentation Values and Expertise interviews Final interview with France Commercial Director

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

description:
Purpose of Position

Own the product agenda for how AI creates real, measurable value across Awin — translating AI capability into shipped product outcomes, not experiments. 

Context 

Thousands of advertisers and publishers who stay on Awin platform because of the people and product behind the service. The next chapter of Awin's product strategy is defined by how deliberately we put AI to work — not as a slogan, but as a set of practical capabilities embedded into what we build and how the business runs. 

Most companies treat AI as a layer bolted onto existing product thinking. We want the opposite: a Head of Product who treats AI as core to the product strategy itself — where it belongs, what it should never touch, and how it compounds value over time rather than producing one-off wins. 

What you'll own 

  • Product strategy for AI-driven value. Define where AI genuinely changes the economics or experience of our product — and where it doesn't. Prioritise like a product leader: value creation and value capture, not novelty.
  • Translate capability into roadmap. Convert what AI can practically do today into a prioritised, sequenced product agenda with clear outcomes — not a lab of disconnected pilots.
  • Own outcomes, not outputs. Every initiative under your remit is judged on measurable business impact — adoption, efficiency, revenue, or customer outcome — not on whether something "uses AI."
  • Partner at exec level. Work directly with leadership to align AI investment with company priorities, and defend that investment in commercial terms.
  • Lead a product team. Hire and develop the product talent needed to execute — with real ownership over people and budget.
  • Set the standard for build vs. buy. Make disciplined calls on when to adopt existing AI tooling versus build proprietary capability, with opportunity cost as the deciding factor.
  • Champion practical adoption over theatre. Internal and external users are your test of success — if a capability isn't used, it isn't done. 

 

Who you are 

  • Product leader with technical fluency. You've run product organisations and you understand, in practical terms, where AI creates leverage versus where it's a distraction.
  • Outcome-obsessed. You think in business impact first, technology second.
  • Commercially sharp. You can defend a roadmap in P&L terms as comfortably as in a product review.
  • Credible with engineering. You can go deep enough on data, APIs, and model capability to make good calls, without needing to be the one building it.
  • A builder of teams, not just plans — you know how to hire and develop product talent that ships. 

What success looks like 

  • A clear, prioritised AI product agenda in place; first initiatives shipped with measurable adoption.
  • A functioning product team; multiple AI-enabled capabilities live and driving demonstrable business outcomes.
  • AI is a defining, differentiated part of Awin's product experience — not a side initiative, but core to how the product wins in market. 

What this role is not

Not an automation function. Not a central bureaucracy that runs projects for other teams. Not a lab for AI experimentation without a business case. This is a product leadership role — where AI is the primary lens, not a side interest.

 

Our Offer

  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

 

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why  

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts. Build the partner channel: primes and integrators, offshore and cable operators, and local partners in each country. Turn every deployment into a reference the next customer can check. Set up the sales machine, then hire and lead the first sellers. 📈 How you will be measured First 3 months: you own the pipeline, have a qualified deal plan for each priority region, and a first paid pilot or LOI is signed. 6 months: paid pilots are running and the first contracts are signed. 12 months: recurring contracts in at least two countries, and your first sales hires are made and ramped. 🤩 This job is your dream job if: You have closed defense or government deals and want to do it again, from zero, where every contract changes the trajectory You like being the second half of a founder pair: the CEO brings operational credibility, you bring the deal You'd rather be on a plane to Tallinn, Constanța or Abu Dhabi than in a forecast meeting You speak engineer well enough to sell sensors, AI and C2 You want to write the sales playbook yourself, then hire the team that runs it 🙅 This job is not for you if: You need a brand, a marketing team and SDRs to sell You have only sold short-cycle SaaS or SMB deals, never through formal procurement You want to manage a large team from day one rather than close deals yourself Sales cycles of 12 to 24 months and 40% travel put you off You are looking for the comfort of a large defense group What we offer A founding role in a seed-stage defense tech company backed by Hexa Fixed salary, variable on signed revenue, BSPCE Offices in Paris, real deployments at sea 🧭 Our recruitment process A first call to get to know each other. A deep dive into two deals you closed. A case study on a real Pelagon challenge, presented to the founders. A conversation with the founders. Reference checks, with your consent. Offer. description: IMT Atlantique, reconnue internationalement pour la qualité de sa recherche, est une école d’ingénieurs de premier plan sous la tutelle du ministère de l'industrie et du numérique, classée dans les trois principaux classements internationaux (THE, SHANGHAI, QS). Le poste est ouvert sur le campus de Rennes au sein du département SRCD (Systèmes Réseaux, Cybersécurité et Droit du numérique). Le département SRCD est composé de 24 enseignant.e.s-chercheurs.euses permanent.e.s, plus de 10 post-doctorant.e.s et ingénieur.e.s contractuel.le.s, et 30 doctorant.e.s. Ses domaines d'activité recouvrent tous les aspects de l'enseignement et de la recherche en systèmes et réseaux au sens large, en cybersécurité, et en droit et économie des activités numériques. Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche, la personne recrutée rejoindra l’équipe SOTERN (Self Protecting the Future Internet) du département D2 du laboratoire IRISA (UMR CNRS 6074), l'un des plus grands laboratoires de recherche français (+ de 850 personnes) dans le domaine de l'informatique et des nouvelles technologies de l'information. Enjeux et profil attendu sur le thématique de recherche Deux enjeux majeurs présentent actuellement un impact conséquent sur la recherche et l’innovation en Cybersécurité. D’un côté, l’intelligence artificielle par ses développements récents et les attendus pour les années à venir décuple les possibilités offertes aux attaquants pour mettre en œuvre de nouvelles attaques, tout autant qu’aux structures défensives (type SOC par exemple) pour détecter, corréler et contrer des incidents de sécurité. D’un autre côté, les cibles des attaques évoluent et les architectures déployées dans les réseaux opérationnels (systèmes industriels, réseaux intra-véhiculaires, avionique, opérateurs d’importance vitale) nécessitent de nouveaux moyens de détection et protection face à une menace grandissante. Le profil recherché pour ce poste s’inscrit ainsi dans la thématique de la sécurité des réseaux au sens large. Il sera plus spécifiquement recherché soit une expertise relative aux architectures, protocoles et algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour la sécurité des réseaux ou de l’IA (apprentissage fédéré, sécurité des architectures d’IA type Model Context Protocol (MCP), etc.), soit une expertise sur la sécurité des réseaux opérationnels (OT) quel qu’en soit le cadre applicatif. Enjeux et profil attendu en enseignement Positionnée sur 3 campus attractifs, IMT Atlantique affiche une forte dynamique internationale tout en restant à taille humaine. Dans ces différents cursus BAC+5 (formations d’ingénieurs et de masters-DNM), les étudiants sont confrontés, via des approches pédagogiques variées, à des situations-problèmes concrets. L’école a ainsi pour ambition de former de jeunes professionnels à fort potentiel, capables de mobiliser un large spectre de compétences en situation réelle, dans des environnements (production, recherche, création d’activité, etc.) et des domaines socio-économiques variés. Impliqué tant en tronc commun que dans les parcours électifs, la personne recrutée contribuera aussi bien dans sa spécialité Cybersécurité que dans des activités transverses, interdisciplinaires ou en lien avec des entreprises : tutorat de projets / stages, soutenances, accompagnement, etc. La personne recrutée sera encouragée à contribuer, dans un esprit de collaboration, à l’évolution cohérente des programmes d’études, en proposant de nouveaux projets, programmes et méthodologies pédagogiques, particulièrement inspirés et soutenus par les exigences et les partenariats industriels. https://www.imt-atlantique.fr/fr/formation En cohérence avec le profil de la personne candidate, il sera demandé de prendre en main les thématiques d’enseignement parmi les suivantes : IA et Cybersécurité (IA offensive, IA pour la protection des infrastructures, sécurité de l’IA), Sécurité des systèmes industriels, participation puis prise de responsabilité de l’organisation du CTF Hack’lantique, et plus largement une participation aux différents enseignements en Cybersécurité. Responsabilité collective et implication dans le développement économique En effet une attention particulière sera portée sur la capacité du candidat à s’impliquer dans la vie collective de l’école : contribuer, ou piloter des projets transverses (par exemple sur la transition écologique, prendre des responsabilités (programmes de formation, projets de recherche, équipes pédagogiques ou de recherche) ou participer à des instances : comité de l’enseignement, conseil d’école, comité social d’administration. En outre dans un environnement de relations privilégiées avec de grands partenaires industriels nationaux et internationaux, ainsi qu’un réseau dense de PME, Start up, l’enseignant chercheur recruté contribuera au rayonnement de l’école et au développement économique, notamment au travers de la valorisation de ses travaux par le dépôt de brevet ou le transfert de technologies. Avec 257 enseignants-chercheurs permanents, 2450 étudiants dont 399 doctorants, IMT Atlantique produit chaque année 655 publications et lève 28.3M€ de fonds de recherche. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

Role Objective 

The Operations Associate is critical in the store team and is responsible for driving profitability and efficiency. The Operations Associate will work closely with the Operations & Visual Manager & Operations Lead in initiating, completing work, and providing feedback to the team to achieve optimal results supporting total store operations.   

Key Job Responsibilities 

  • Execute inventory management processes effectively with a focus on maximizing inventory accuracy and reducing shrink
  • Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the General Manager to escalate process or system gaps
  • Support execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management
  • Maintain and champion strong visual standards for the sales floor
  • Work closely with reporting, budgets, expenses, inventory control, supplies, vendor relationships, technology, and facilities to ensure maintained and maximized
  • Support a safe work environment and efficient operation through strong stockroom standards and processes
  • Move dynamically on the retail floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team and guests
  • Execute company-level operations-focused directives, projects and initiates, in partnership with the Operations & Visual Manager & Operations Lead.  
  • Assists in processing shipment and ensuring product flow; including but not limited to visual merchandising placement and daily replenishment excellence
  • Demonstrate strong business acumen by leveraging metrics to support business-driving strategies
  • Resolve client needs quickly & effectively ensuring customer satisfaction
  • Identify product concerns and communicate inventory needs to support the business goals
  • Support other areas of the business, including Sales & Service and Cashier, as needed 

Operations Associate Qualifications 

  • Preferred prior work experience in a client-centric, sales & operational environment
  • Passion for customer service and delivering exceptional experiences
  • High energy, upbeat and enthusiastic with the ability to integrate fun and work
  • Self-motivated with a desire to achieve results and excel individually, and as a team
  • Fosters genuine connection through empathy, compassion, integrity and building trusting relationships
  • Ability to lift, push, carry or otherwise move up to 50 pounds

All employees' availability must suit the needs of the business, which are subject to change.
