description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

Partner Marketing exists to fuel the growth and success of Wellhub's global partner network of gyms, studios and wellness businesses. The Senior Manager, Partner Marketing (France & Benelux) leads Partner Marketing strategy and execution for these markets, as part of Wellhub's regional EU Partner Marketing team.

This person will act as the regional Point of Contact (POC) for Partner Marketing in France and Benelux, owning the local Business-to- Partner value proposition, brand positioning, network growth and engagement and, fitness industry events, working closely with Partnerships, local and cross-functional Marketing, Wellbeing Engagement, Product Development and Revenue teams to align strategy and execution. Reporting to the Partner Marketing Director, EU, this role combines strategic ownership of the region with hands-on execution.

This role directly impacts the growth and satisfaction of Wellhub's partner network in France and Benelux, contributing to the team's broader goals around partner network growth, partner engagement, and partner satisfaction (PSAT).

 

YOUR IMPACT

  • Market-Specific Value Proposition: Develop and implement the local Business to Partner value proposition across all partner-facing materials and touchpoints for France and Benelux.
  • Brand Awareness & Positioning: Build Wellhub's presence and credibility within the regional fitness industry through relationships with industry associations/alliances, sponsorships, events, media/publications, and key opinion leaders (KOLs).
  • Strategic Partner Growth (B2P2C): Lead go-to-market strategy for partner launches, relaunches, and dedicated campaigns and promotions to end users and clients, driving growth with existing partners.
  • Strategic Partner Engagement: Build partner trust through structured engagement initiatives, including fitness industry events, partner conferences and summits.
  • Network Growth Support: Support the Demand Generation team’s strategy with local market insights and develop sales enablement materials to drive growth across the partner network.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with Partnerships,  User Growth, Corporate communication, Content, Revenue teams local and global level to align initiatives with company-wide strategy.
  • Budget Ownership: Manage the regional Partner Marketing budget for France and Benelux, allocating resources across campaigns, events and other marketing initiatives to drive results and maximize ROI.
  • Data-Driven Marketing: Use performance data and partner insights to inform, prioritize and continuously optimize Partner Marketing initiatives in the region.
  • AI-Driven Productivity: Autonomously identify and apply AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to raise the team's level of automation — streamlining repetitive tasks, accelerating content, reporting and campaign production, and embedding AI-assisted workflows into day-to-day ways of working. Continuously build personal AI fluency and share practices that help the broader team work smarter.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Native/fluent in French and fluent in English, based in France with deep knowledge of local market and fitness industry culture.
  • Working knowledge of Dutch is a plus, given the scope across Benelux markets.
  • [+8] years of experience in Marketing, ideally with exposure to Partner, Channel, Product or Revenue Marketing in a B2B or B2B2C environment.
  • Proven ability to build value propositions, brand positioning and go-to-market strategies, and to execute them independently as a regional lead.
  • Comfortable managing institutional relationships with industry KOLs, associations and strategic partners.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Data-driven approach to marketing decisions, comfortable with CRM and marketing analytics tools.
  • Fluent English is mandatory.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that native/fluent French, prior Marketing experience, and English proficiency are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU 

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. 

HEALTHCARE: Health insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!


Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here. 

Wellhub was named one of the Best Engineering Teams and Top IT Companies to Work For in Portugal! Join a team where technology, purpose, and wellbeing come together. Read more about our award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

 

 #LI-HYBRID

description: Venez rejoindre l'IMT Mines Alès, grande école de prestige qui se classe parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs sur le plan national et mondial et implantée à Alès, ville à taille humaine, capitale des Cévennes où la qualité de vie est fortement appréciée par ses habitants. Créée en 1843, IMT Mines Alès compte à ce jour 1400 élèves (dont 250 étrangers) et 380 personnels. L’école dispose de 3 centres de recherche et d’enseignement de haut niveau scientifique et technologique, qui œuvrent dans les domaines des matériaux et du génie civil (C2MA), de l’environnement et des risques (CREER), de l’intelligence artificielle et du génie industriel et numérique (CERIS). Elle dispose de 12 plateformes technologiques et compte 1600 entreprises partenaires. Pour en savoir plus : https://www.imt-mines-ales.fr Vous êtes rattaché(e) au Centre de Recherche et d’Enseignement en Environnement et Risques (CREER) de l'IMT Mines Alès et dans l'unité de recherche : HSM. Ce travail s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet PREV’IA qui s’intéresse à la connaissance et à la prévision des ressources en eaux de la nappe plioquaternaire de la plaine de Roussillon, et de la source du Lez qui alimente Montpellier en eau potable. Votre travail s’inscrira dans la continuité d’une thèse en cours au sein de l’UMR HSM (équipe HYTAKE), portant sur la durabilité de la ressource en eau karstique (aquifère du Lez) alimentant une métropole méditerranéenne (Montpellier) en contexte de changement climatique. Votre mission : Utiliser les concepts émergeants dans les approches de « Physics Informed Machine Learning » (PIML) pour évaluer les intérêts d’une synergie en modélisation hydrogéologique : (1) à base conceptuelle d’une part et (2) à base de réseaux de neurones informés, ou complémentés, par la physique. L’approche PIML (Physics Informed Machine Learning) est développée, avec deux courants : (i) les Physics Informed Architecture (PIA) : intégration de connaissances physiques dans l’architecture du modèle (couches cachées) ; et (ii) les Physics Informed Loss Function (PILF) : combinaison de modélisations physiques (équations différentielles) et boîte noire, fusionnées dans la fonction de coût (terme de régularisation). Les deux méthodes pourront être explorées. Les modèles proposés pourront être utilisés pour déterminer l’évolution de certaines grandeurs hydrologiques en réponse au changement climatique. L’IMT Mines Alès s’engage à mettre en place les aménagements nécessaires pour les personnes en situation de handicap, afin de garantir un environnement de travail inclusif et accessible. description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.
  • Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.
  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.
  • Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.
  • Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.
  • Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.
  • Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.
  • Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.
  • Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.
  • 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.
  • CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.
  • Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.
  • Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
  • Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

We are building the leading software and electronics platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l’industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l’avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses quatre missions : former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l’innovation, en un cercle vertueux et porteur d’innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche place IMT Mines Albi comme une école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT : l’industrie du futur responsable ; l’énergie, l’économie circulaire et la société ; l’ingénierie, la santé et le bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s’est dotée en 2023, pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en sept grandes actions, répondant aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT auquel elle appartient. IMT Mines Albi représente : 985 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation ; 300 personnels ; un budget consolidé de 32 M€ ; trois centres de formation et de recherche : Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A), RAPSODEE et Centre Génie Industriel. Le Centre Institut Clément Ader Albi (ICA-A) est un centre de formation et de recherche d’IMT Mines Albi. Il rassemble 70 personnes, dont 20 enseignants-chercheurs. Au titre de la formation, il est un acteur de la formation ingénieur généraliste d’IMT Mines Albi, sous statut étudiant ou apprenti, et porte l’option « Matériaux et procédés avancés pour les transports de demain ». Au titre de la recherche, il est partie intégrante de l’Institut Clément Ader (ICA – UMR CNRS 5312), laboratoire rassemblant 250 personnes et développant des thématiques scientifiques axées sur l’ingénierie et la mécanique des matériaux, notamment dans le domaine de l’aéronautique. Ses cinq établissements de tutelle sont l’INSA de Toulouse, l’ISAE-SUPAERO, l’Université Paul Sabatier, IMT Mines Albi et le CNRS. Site Internet de l’ICA : https://ica.cnrs.fr/ L’ICA traite des études sur les structures, les systèmes et les processus mécaniques. Ses secteurs d’activité sont les industries mécaniques, avec un accent particulier sur l’aérospatiale, l’espace, le transport et l’énergie. Le centre Institut Clément Ader Albi contribue aux quatre groupes de recherche de l’ICA : Matériaux et Structures Composites ; Surfaces, Usinage, Matériaux, Outillages ; Métrologie, Identification, Contrôle, Surveillance ; Modélisation des Systèmes et Microsystèmes Mécaniques. Le champ d’action d’ICA-A est d’optimiser les outillages ou les procédés de mise en forme des matériaux (métaux, composites, polymères, verres, etc.) ainsi que d’étudier les relations entre microstructure, procédé et comportement, en particulier pour les secteurs de l’aéronautique et du spatial. Ses activités sont fortement expérimentales, mais également numériques. ICA-A possède sa propre plateforme de recherche sur le campus d’IMT Mines Albi, la plateforme MIMAUSA. ICA-A est une Zone à Régime Restrictif (ZRR) depuis 2021. DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : De manière générale, la personne recrutée participera aux projets pédagogiques de l’école, aux missions de formation, aux activités de recherche et de transfert de technologies, au montage et au suivi des activités contractuelles ainsi qu’aux collaborations nationales et internationales. Elle contribuera activement au développement de ces activités et pourra être amenée à exercer des responsabilités administratives et d’encadrement. La personne recrutée aura notamment vocation à assurer : des responsabilités pédagogiques : responsable de cycle d’enseignement, responsable d’option, responsable de Master ou Mastère, responsable d’unité d’enseignement ; et/ou des responsabilités en recherche : directeur de centre, directeur de centre adjoint, responsable de groupe de recherche, responsable d’axe de recherche, responsable de plateforme ; et/ou des responsabilités liées au transfert industriel et au développement économique ; et/ou des responsabilités transverses, comme par exemple : responsable de processus ou sous-processus, responsable thématique international. Activités de formation Dans le programme de formation du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée participera aux activités pédagogiques et d’enseignement d’IMT Mines Albi. Activités de recherche Dans le programme de recherche du centre ICA-A, la personne recrutée : proposera une démarche scientifique pour le développement de méthodes innovantes d’exploitation et d’analyse de données et d’utilisation de l’IA, capables de répondre aux exigences d’un dialogue essais/calcul multi-échelles. 2644 - Regional Director, Digital  - GCS

Role Summary and Impact

Team Honda is on a transformative journey with Honda Motor Europe to aid data-driven decisioning, prove marketing effectiveness and drive incremental order growth for its four divisions – Automobiles, Motorcycles, Marine and Power Products.

To bring this vision to life, Honda has embarked on a deep strategic partnership with WPP.  We are building a bespoke, integrated agency model focused on one clear ambition: to drive desire for Honda products, grow consideration and increase order intake.

At the heart of this collaboration is WPP Open, our intelligent marketing operating system. WPP Open blends WPP's world-class creative and media talent with cutting-edge AI and technology to create hyper-personalised, immersive brand experiences. Our role is to connect with customers at every touchpoint, from global brand campaigns to individual customer journeys. By integrating media, strategy, data, and technology, we will maximise efficiency and effectiveness, accelerating growth for the entire Honda portfolio.

Team Honda is seeking a Regional Digital Director to lead the digital and in-platform advancement of our global digital activity.  The role is responsible for ensuring that our activation operations map to the strategic directions of Honda Motor Europe (HME) and support the ambitions of transparent, sustainable, data-driven decisioning. 

Reporting to the Global Client Lead, the successful candidate will work with WPP Media specialist teams across a variety of strategic programs designed to ensure performance excellence in the markets of Automobiles, Motorbikes, Marine and Power Products.

This role requires a strategic and execution-focused leader with deep expertise in biddable media and data-driven marketing, ideally as these pertain to driving orders for Automobiles, Motorbikes, Marine and Power Products.

The role will include supporting on HME operational frameworks including digital brand safety and suitability, audience targeting frameworks and digital data collection.  The role will also extend into data-driven programs, focusing on the successful deployment and update of data solutions feeding in-platform execution.

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of culture and our people.  It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other.  In this role, it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

Be extraordinary by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity

Create an open environment by balancing people and client experiences by cultivating trust

Lead with optimism by championing growth, learning and development to mobilize the enterprise.

  • The ideal candidate will have a strong background in digital media operations for planning and execution, proven leadership experience and the ability to collaborate across markets, platforms, internal and external stakeholders.
  • Extensive experience in biddable media operations and execution within a large-scale organisation or agency environment.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing teams and driving digital transformation.
  • Strong expertise in data-driven marketing and the integration of 1PD data sets into digital platforms and digital audience targeting technology.
  • Experience working with brand safety and verification platform partners, their commercial model and the impact on to media platform decisioning.
  • Deep understanding of channel maturity models, test-and-learn and incrementality frameworks and digital media best practises.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate insights into strategic action.
  • Extensive experience working with the biddable platforms themselves towards gaining HME a competitive advantage.
  • Experience and familiarity with Ad Operations processes to ensure best practise processes are in place for digital media execution.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/ About You 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively Compensation $178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation. Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances. While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week. description: SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories - the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed. The Role As a Computational Geometry Engineer, you own the geometry core of our Manufacturing Intelligence stack - the engine that takes an arbitrary customer CAD model and reasons about how to build it, and then proves that we built it right. You own the code that runs in the factory. What We're Looking For 5+ years building geometry-heavy software in production - CAD/CAM, geometry kernels, feature recognition, CAE/simulation preparation, metrology, or comparable. B-rep and Mesh Depth. You think natively in topology and NURBS. Feature recognition, defeaturing, robust booleans, offsetting, surface/surface intersection, healing and repair. You know exactly why floating-point robustness destroys naive implementations - and what to do about it. You have had the opportunity to delve into complex CAD models and are able to assess their quality in both quantitative and qualitative terms (gaps in edge, spikes in loops, tiny elements, twisted surfaces...) and ultimately predict which types of processing might be challenged. Kernel Fluency. Hands-on with a geometry kernel - Parasolid, OpenCASCADE, ACIS, or equivalent - and the judgment to know which parts can be developed in-house in order to retain full control and IP rights, and which parts too complex (e.g. advanced solvers) should be integrated as 3rd parties. Comfortable with mesh and point-cloud processing (libigl, Open3D, CGAL, PCL) alongside solid modelling.You know well STEP file format and about integration into collaboration & interoperability processes. Technical Excellence. Strong command of modern C++ (17+), plus Python for rapid iteration. Rust is welcome. You write and test performant code. Manufacturing Instinct. Some knowledge of fabrication techniques-casting, stamping, composites, and additive manufacturing-alongside toolsets for evaluating design manufacturability, risk profiles, quality standards, and cost factors. End-to-End Ownership. Algorithm design through to a shipped, tested, maintained service. First Principles Thinker. You reason by physics and mathematics, not analogy. When an algorithm fails on a real part, you know whether the bug is in the code, the model, or the assumption. Industrial Grit. You want to stand next to the machine in Germany and watch your output run. The feedback loop between your code and cutting metal is the point. Maniacal Urgency. Speed is our only edge. You thrive in the "chaos-to-order" phase of a startup. On-site: Ability to work in person at our HQ in Zurich, Switzerland. What we're not looking for Researchers who want to publish and hand off. You ship. CAD users. This is a role for people who build the tools, not drive them. Engineers who need a clean spec. The problem is defined by the part, the machine, and the customer - you'll go find it. People who treat "it works on the test model" as done. Real customer CAD is broken, degenerate, and adversarial. That is the job. Engineers who are uncomfortable with ambiguity or rapidly changing priorities. What we offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your work directly enables production of mission-critical hardware for defense and space. Total Ownership: High-stakes autonomy in your domain. You own both the problems and the solutions - and have the authority to execute. The Environment: Access to a 8,000 m² state-of-the-art facility featuring 5-axis CNCs, industrial robots, and industrial 3D printers. Your algorithms run on real hardware from day one. The Team: "Special Forces" model. Everyone senior, everyone ships. No politics, no bureaucracy. Direct feedback, high standards. Compensation: Competitive salary + meaningful equity. Location: Zurich HQ, with occasional time at Factory ONE in Munich. Apply Resume: Focus on geometry systems you've built and owned. GitHub/Portfolio: Show us the hard problem you solved - code, papers, or parts that came off a machine because of you. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? What would you build first? With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

About the job
OpenTable is looking for a highly motivated, practical, and business-oriented Senior Counsel, Privacy & Product to join our Legal team. You will serve as a trusted advisor to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing strategic and practical counsel across product development, privacy and data protection, artificial intelligence, information security, consumer protection, and related regulatory matters. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.
  • Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.
  • Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.
  • Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing. 
  • Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.
  • Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, including significant experience advising on privacy, data protection, technology, and product matters, preferably in-house at a technology, consumer, marketplace, or other high-growth company.
  • J.D. from an accredited U.S. law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar, or equivalent legal qualification and authorization to practice law in the United Kingdom.
  • Deep knowledge of U.S. and global privacy and data protection laws, including GDPR and U.S. state privacy laws, as well as global consumer protection laws, with demonstrated experience translating complex legal and regulatory requirements into practical product and business guidance.
  • Significant experience providing product counseling, including partnering directly with Product and Engineering teams on new products, features, data uses, and technology initiatives from development through launch.
  • Experience supporting or helping lead a global privacy program, including privacy governance, policies, compliance frameworks, and cross-functional implementation.
  • Experience advising on information security and cybersecurity matters, including security requirements, incident response, and related regulatory obligations.
  • Strong judgment, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to assess risk, navigate ambiguity, and provide practical advice to cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience advising on artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including legal and regulatory considerations associated with developing, deploying, or procuring AI-enabled products and services.
  • Experience working within a complex global organization or corporate group and partnering effectively with enterprise-level legal, privacy, security, compliance, or governance functions.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, or similar privacy or AI certification preferred.

Benefits and Perks

  • 5 weeks paid vacation
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year
  • Focus on mental health and well-being:
    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
    • Company-paid subscription to Headspace
    • Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
  • Paid parental leave
  • Time off for your birthday
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Focus on your career growth:
    • Development Dollars
    • Leadership development
    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings
  • Travel Discounts
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Income protection and life assurance
  • Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice
  • Pension plan contributions
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Bike2Work
  • Season ticket loan
  • Social events & Thursday happy hours
  • Free lunch 2 days per week

The best connections happen face-to-face, whether you’re sitting down to dinner or having coffee with a coworker. That’s why OpenTable has adopted a hybrid workplace model. This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility.

Work Environment & Flexibility

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. As a team member with us, you will benefit from a schedule tailored to accommodate a global workforce operating across multiple time zones. While the majority of your responsibilities may align with conventional business hours, there will be instances where you are expected to manage communications - via calls, Slack messages, or emails - outside of regular working hours to effectively collaborate with international colleagues, respond to restaurant partners, and/or address urgent matters. OpenTable will always abide by and consider local laws and regulations.

Inclusion

We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. We know the best ideas come when we bring different voices to the table, so we're building a team as dynamic as the diners and restaurants we serve—and fostering a culture where everyone feels welcome to be themselves.

If you need any reasonable adjustments during the application/interview process, or on the job, we’re here to support you. Please reach out to your recruiter to request any accommodations.

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels organization is a fun, entrepreneurial, start-up team where you can have outsized impact. Simplicity is at the core of our products. We pride ourselves on delivering the smoothest and most intuitive hotel booking experience. For hotels, we make it easy to drive incremental bookings so they can focus on the craft of hosting. We aspire to facilitate hotel discovery and serendipity at scale, benefitting guests and hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

Airbnb is building the world's largest supply of boutique and independent hotels on its platform. To accelerate that growth, we're hiring a Senior Demand Generation Specialist to own the inbound engine for our Hotels Acquisition team.

This is a high-impact, strategic and hands-on role sitting at the intersection of marketing and sales. This is Airbnb's first-ever B2B demand generation role. You'll build the Hotels inbound motion from the ground up across EMEA, as a 12-month pilot that will shape how we scale it globally.

A Typical Day: 

  • Define and own the EMEA inbound strategy and roadmap, prioritising the channels and initiatives that will drive the most hotel go-lives
  • Build and scale multi-channel inbound programs (email, paid, SEO, content, events, partnerships) targeting independent hotels, boutique chains, and hotel groups globally
  • Own the full funnel from lead capture to MQL handoff, including lead scoring, routing, and CRM hygiene in Salesforce, in collaboration with RevOps Teams
  • Design Linkedin campaigns in coordination with regional AE teams to target high-priority segments and geographies
  • Develop outbound-assist sequences (via tools like Mixmax or Outreach) to complement AE prospecting
  • Partner with Global Marketing to build collateral, landing pages, and nurture flows that speak to hotel operator pain points
  • Track, report, and optimize against pipeline contribution metrics: MQLs, MQL-to-SQL conversion, cost per lead, and influenced revenue
  • Run co-marketing and referral programs with industry partners (channel managers, PMSes, hospitality associations)
  • Build business cases for each campaign, secure budget from stakeholders, and show clear ROI
  • Run a test-and-learn approach: launch quickly, measure, cut what doesn't work and scale what does
  • Use AI and automation to scale campaign creation, content and lead nurture
  • Work with Connectivity, Events, Country Managers and AEs to turn webinars, events and partnerships into measurable pipeline

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B demand generation or growth marketing, ideally within marketplace, hospitality tech, or SaaS environments
  • Proven track record of building inbound programs that generate measurable sales pipeline, including experience building a demand gen function from scratch (startup, scale-up, or new-business environment)
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce, marketing automation tools (MixMax, Outreach, or similar), and paid channels
  • Strong analytical, systems-driven approach; comfortable running campaigns yourself, not just briefing others
  • Data-driven: you own your funnel metrics and can connect campaign activity to revenue impact
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate campaigns and create content at scale
  • Strong sales alignment instincts; you treat AEs as internal customers
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: able to shape your own scope, make the case for investment, and adjust quickly based on results
  • Fluent in written and spoken English; additional European languages a plus
  • Experience operating globally across multiple regions/languages a plus

Why This Role:

Airbnb Hotels is one of the company's highest-priority supply growth initiatives. This role sits at the center of that effort, with direct visibility to senior leadership and the ability to shape how the world's most recognized travel brand expands into professional hospitality. 

As the first person in this role, you'll help show what B2B demand generation can do for Airbnb Hotels. While this is a 12-month fixed-term contract, a successful pilot could lead to the role continuing beyond the initial term.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

France Annual Pay Range
€74.000—€92.000 EUR

 

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit  wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.

Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.

OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.

The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.

OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.

By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.

Sr. Director, Business Intelligence

In this high-profile and important role, you’ll be asked to take accountability for data and reporting solutions we develop and maintain for one of our most important clients. 

Leading a globally distributed team of technical reporting data specialists, you will be asked to design, implement, and deliver reporting and data provisioning solutions for digital and traditional media. You will be the voice of Amazon reporting and data needs within DTA, WPP’s Data, Technology and Analytics arm, borrowing from and contributing to the Amazon specific data provisioning and reporting product, structuring team staff and processes. You will be the expert clients go to when reporting and business intelligence requirements emerge or evolve. Most importantly, you must have the technical ability / agility to customize to ensure client and media teams get access to the right data and insights to make the most of our client’s media investments, and in turn ensure high client satisfaction. 

Reporting into DTA SVP for Global Reporting Services and the OpenDoor Global DTA Lead, you’ll also be asked to represent the needs of and solutions developed for the client in wider reporting initiatives, and influence the product vision and strategy within this space.

  • Own reports and data provisioning solutions for the client, taking direct accountability for the quality of the team’s solutions, representing them to clients and working with media leadership to drive successful adoption
  • Demonstrate firsthand understanding of client and media team needs, and lead Business Analysts in the translation of expressed needs into clear and structured requirements for engineers and BI developers
  • Work with clients and media leadership to establish consensus on the prioritization of requirements for development, using your knowledge of requirements and the technical solution to steer the conversation
  • Lead the design of technical solutions to meet requirements, including the scoping and estimation of work to develop
  • Provide strategic coordination across disciplines on the Amazon account (Media, Measurement/Analytics, Data Excellence, Leadership)
  • Hire, train, and mentor a team of data engineers and reporting specialists, ensuring they have the environment to deliver their best work
  • Provide hands-on leadership, leaning in to support the team when needed, and driving continual improvement in the way we ingest, store, transform and visualize data
  • Partner with Data Excellence, and Engineering as well as Measurement, Analytics and Investment leadership to ensure reporting solutions are incorporating best practice metrics to assess performance, which in turn link to client business goals
  • Be the voice of the client within DTA reporting product and service steering groups, directly influencing the ongoing development of supporting data & technology infrastructure
  • Provide support and training to users of reporting solutions, with the aim of empowering them to be more self-sufficient in overcoming these issues.

Skills and Experience

  • Experience as a business intelligence or reporting specialists, preferably at a media agency or related company (e.g. publisher, ad tech, client marketing org)
  • Experience designing and developing intuitive data visualizations with business intelligence software (e.g. PowerBi, Tableau, Looker, Datastudio) that empower end users
  • Strong knowledge of using data infrastructure and cloud data management technologies, as well as data prep and ETL processes, to deliver robust data infrastructure
  • Experience with digital marketing platforms and the data they generate, in particular Google Marketing Platform, Facebook, Twitter etc. Knowledge of their API’s a plus.
  • Experience with WPP Media’s DPAM process and OMS, with particular benefit coming from experience with Campaign Management (formerly Olive) and Campaign Governance (formerly OCTRA)
  • Experience helping set clear strategy, designing technical solutions, proactively managing feature roadmaps, and organizing technical resources to deliver it
  • Excellent and adaptable written and verbal communications style, being able to translate non-technical use cases into technical requirements
  • Strong influencing skills, able to represent and defend your data solutions with senior clients
  • An ability to collaborate in cross-functional teams, and directly influence others to drive adoption of solutions and overcome upstream barriers to implementation
  • Experience leading, nurturing and coaching high-performing technical resources
  • A passion for data excellence and integrity, and a commitment to supporting others and providing better solutions to support it.

Desirable

  • Specific experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS), in particular S3, RedShift, and DBT.
  • A general understanding of how data is tracked and exchanged in the process of digital advertising (e.g. role of adservers and other third-party providers of campaign health performance metrics such as DoubleVerify)

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. description: Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows. We have grown past $40M ARR while remaining a small team, and we care deeply about operating efficiently across the entire company. For many enterprises, Langdock is becoming the place where most of the net-new work is produced. As people and agents create more documents, analyses, decisions, and automations inside AI interfaces, the context and data behind that work accumulate within Langdock. This gives us the opportunity to earn a larger role in their technology stack by building a platform they choose to rely on. Our ambition is to build that platform for European enterprises while preserving their control over data, model providers, and deployment environments. We have made meaningful progress at the application layer, but much of the foundation beneath it still needs to be built. You can watch the Meet the engineering team video to get a feeling for how we work. The role Distributed Systems Engineers solve our most complex technical problems inside and across Langdock's shared services when existing building blocks or standard architectures are insufficient. These are problems where correctness under failure, performance, scale, security, and cost interact. This is a project-oriented role rather than ownership of one permanent layer. You might spend a period on distributed execution, then move into storage architecture, workload isolation, or model serving as company priorities change. The constant is sustained investigation of unfamiliar systems and responsibility for turning that understanding into a production system. Systems Engineers own the difficult mechanism and the measurable improvement it creates, whether in correctness, capability, performance, reliability, or cost. They operate what they build, while the Platform owner remains accountable for the service contract and long-term lifecycle around it. What you might work on The systems agenda includes: Distributed state and execution. Design systems that remain correct when work is concurrent, long-running, retried, resumed, or moved between processes. Define explicit invariants for ordering, idempotency, recovery, and tenant isolation. Storage and data systems. Improve how large volumes of customer and agent-generated data are stored, versioned, moved, and recovered while preserving consistency, data residency, and predictable performance. Secure compute for agents. Develop the isolation, runtime, and scheduling mechanisms behind a shared sandbox service for untrusted code. The system needs persistent filesystems, deny-by-default networking, scoped mounts, fast startup, suspension, resumption, and predictable scheduling without weakening the security boundary. Inference systems. Improve the serving systems beneath the Model Gateway, optimizing throughput, latency, accelerator utilization, reliability, and cost. The work is measurement driven: understand the workload, identify the actual bottleneck, and decide where changes to serving, scheduling, caching, model format, or hardware create structural advantage. Resource scheduling and isolation. Make CPU, memory, storage, network, and accelerator capacity explicit so one workload cannot degrade another. Improve placement, admission control, backpressure, autoscaling, and recovery across deployment environments. Billing and usage metering. Build the concurrent metering mechanism behind the billing capability, accounting for heterogeneous units such as model tokens and sandbox compute time. It must stay correct when many workloads report concurrently, events arrive late or more than once, and long-running jobs reserve capacity before their final usage is known. This involves idempotent ingestion, atomic reservations, reconciliation, and auditable records. You will start with one focused problem based on your experience and the team's priorities. The expectation is not broad activity across every domain; it is a substantial improvement in the capability, performance, reliability, or economics of the system you take on. Tech stack Go and TypeScript in one Bazel monorepo, with implementation choices driven by the system Linux, containers, microVMs, filesystems, and networking Protobuf and gRPC for service contracts Kubernetes across GCP, AWS, Azure, and on-premises deployments Terraform and Terragrunt for infrastructure orchestration PostgreSQL and Redis where durable metadata or coordination requires them Open-source model serving and accelerator infrastructure You do not need prior experience with every item. You do need enough systems depth to enter an unfamiliar part of the stack, understand its behavior, and make consequential changes safely. How we work We operate with high trust and autonomy in squads of 3 to 4 engineers. A squad owns its roadmap, prioritization, technical decisions, and operation in production. Engineers are expected to find the context they need, ask for input when it improves the outcome, and move work forward without waiting for every next step to be assigned. We align asynchronously before scheduling a meeting. Product requirement documents (PRDs) define the user problem, intended outcome, and constraints. Design documents make architectural boundaries, tradeoffs, failure modes, migrations, and rollouts explicit. People read and challenge the thinking asynchronously; once the context is shared, a short in-office discussion or whiteboard session usually resolves the remaining questions quickly. We optimize for leverage. Engineers choose the AI tools that work for them, supported by clear ticket context, focused branches, automated tests, and AI review before human review. We also invest in observability, migration tooling, automated recovery, and runbooks so recurring product maintenance does not depend on someone remembering a manual step. The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix. What we are looking for You have owned technically difficult production systems in areas such as distributed systems, databases, runtimes, inference, networking, or storage. You operate what you build and remain responsible for it after deployment. You reason from first principles, form testable hypotheses, and use measurement to understand unfamiliar behavior. You investigate beyond the first working solution until you understand the underlying mechanism. Given an underspecified problem, you identify the most important invariant, decide where depth will change the outcome, and defend what you deliberately leave out. You reason precisely about concurrency, isolation, ordering, data loss, and failure, while finding pragmatic ways to improve performance, reliability, or cost without unnecessary complexity. You use AI tools as leverage while verifying their output and retaining ownership of the result. You communicate complex systems clearly, expose uncertainty, and work constructively with others. This is an experienced individual-contributor role. You should be able to independently investigate an unfamiliar problem, design a solution, ship it, and operate it in production. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.000 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen. Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger: Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Geschäftsführung, Finance, Data und Sales zusammen und bereitest Erkenntnisse verständlich und entscheidungsorientiert auf. Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Du verstehst Marketing nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt. Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren. Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus. Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung. Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen, statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Marketer verstehen, was zu tun ist. Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Deine Vorteile bei Pammys Echter Einfluss: Deine Analysen landen nicht in einer Präsentation, sondern direkt in operativen und strategischen Entscheidungen. Unternehmerisches Controlling: Du bekommst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und wirst zum Sparringspartner für die jeweiligen Führungskräfte. Außergewöhnliche Skalierung: Du begleitest ein Unternehmen auf dem Weg vom mittleren 8-stelligen in den mittleren 9-stelligen Umsatzbereich. Komplexität, an der du wachsen kannst: E-Commerce, Marketing, internationale Märkte, eigene Logistik, Sourcing und Millionen von Produkten ergeben ein Finance-Umfeld, das weit über klassisches Controlling hinausgeht. Gestaltung statt Verwaltung: Viele Strukturen entstehen gerade erst. Du kannst Prozesse, Dashboards, KPIs und Steuerungsmodelle aktiv mit aufbauen. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Gute Analysen werden schnell in Entscheidungen übersetzt. High-Performance-Umfeld: Klare Ziele, messbare Ergebnisse, hohe Eigenverantwortung und der Anspruch, jeden Bereich kontinuierlich besser zu machen. Entwicklungsperspektive: Mit dem weiteren Wachstum entstehen zusätzliche Verantwortungsbereiche und Führungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Finance-Teams. description:
Purpose of Position 

Awin's Unlock the Clock (UTC) programme is building the evidence base and infrastructure to move measurement beyond last click, using deterministic, CDN/edge-level signals and advanced data connections from publishers to show the full-funnel and AI-discovery influence that today's attribution misses. The value of that dataset scales with the quality and scale of the publishers inside it.

This role exists to acquire and retain those publishers. The Senior Partnerships Manager, Media & Data owns the end-to-end pursuit of medium-to-large global media publications and publisher groups, from first conversation to signature, to live, verified data flowing, and is responsible for building the commercial value exchange that makes Awin the leading partner for a premium publisher to work with. The focus in year one is a small number of flagship, tier-one lighthouse partnerships that prove the model and become the reference cases the rest of the market follows.

This is a new, dedicated role. It is not general publisher account management: the postholder is hired to spearhead these relationships and nothing else.

 

Key Responsibilities 

Land flagship media partnerships

  • Build and own a global target list of medium-to-large media publications and publisher groups whose audience, content and commerce activity make them high-value contributors to Awin’s deterministic dataset.
  • Own the full pursuit cycle for those targets: identify, qualify, pitch, negotiate, close and hand into onboarding, personally leading senior conversations with commercial, ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.
  • Deliver a defined number of tier-one lighthouse partnerships in year one: signed tracking addendum, technically onboarded, and verifiably recording events at agreed volume and quality thresholds.
  • Convert those wins into reference cases, including case studies, joint narratives and referenceable contacts, that materially shorten the sales cycle for the next tranche of publishers.

Build the publisher value proposition

  • Own and continuously sharpen the answer to “what’s in it for the publisher”: the commercial, editorial and strategic reasons a premium media owner shares CDN and wider data signals with Awin.
  • Construct and negotiate the value exchange, including new revenue lines, advertiser demand, insight and benchmarking, or commercial terms
  • Work with Product, Marketing and the workstream owners to translate AI-visibility and full-funnel capability into publisher-facing propositions, collateral and retailer pricing
  • Help each partner build their own value proposition, so the publisher has something new and differentiated to sell to advertisers, not simply a new tag on their site.
  • Equip partners to sell that proposition through joint collateral, benchmarks, proof points and training for their commercial and editorial teams.
  • Feed publisher objections, commercial expectations and market intelligence back into the project roadmap so the product earns the deals rather than the deals stretching the product.

Own the technical and contractual path to live

  • Run the integration conversation with publishes, covering CDN/edge worker or plugin deployment, tag and consent implications, data scope and page performance, with Awin product brought in for deep technical detail.
  • Own the commercial and legal process end to end, including tracking addendum, data-sharing terms, privacy and consent positions, working with Legal and Privacy to reach repeatable rather than bespoke agreements.
  • Hold partners accountable to going live and staying live, tracking signed-to-verified-event conversion

Global reach and internal leadership

  • Operate globally from day one across UK, EU and US, coordinating with local Awin market and Publisher Development teams and identified regional representatives rather than duplicating them.
  • Act as the single point of accountability and internal voice for media partner acquisition within the project: represent the workstream in relevant forums and provide clear, honest pipeline and progress reporting to SteerCo level.
  • Partner with the advertiser-facing teams so publisher supply and advertiser demand are sequenced together: the data has to be sold on as well as signed up.
  • Represent Awin externally at key industry events, conferences and partner forums to promote Unlock the Clock and Awin’s fuller-funnel measurement strategy to the media community.
  • Build the playbook: document what works, so the model can be scaled by others and, in time, by a small team reporting into this role.

Success measures (first 12 months)

  • Signed and live tier-one lighthouse partnerships against an agreed target, evidenced by verified event volume
  • A qualified, weighted global pipeline of medium-to-large media groups with credible forward visibility.
  • A repeatable publisher proposition and commercial framework: not a series of bespoke negotiations.
  • Partner-facing value propositions live in market, with at least two partners actively selling an Awin-enabled proposition of their own.
  • Referenceable partners willing to advocate publicly, at least one flagship case study in market, and Awin represented on stage at relevant industry events.
  • Measurable advertiser-side pull-through from the partnerships landed, agreed jointly with the advertiser teams.

 

Key Skills

  • 7+ years in commercial, partnership or account leadership roles, with a significant portion earned publisher-side or media-owner-side.
  • An established personal network of senior contacts across the media and publishing world that can be activated from day one. This is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.
  • Experience representing an organisation publicly: speaking at industry events, on panels or at partner forums.
  • Demonstrable track record of senior-level relationships inside premium publishers or media groups, including commercial directors, heads of ecommerce, editorial and digital leadership.
  • Experience negotiating and closing commercial agreements with, or on behalf of, publishers: tenancy, CPC, CPA, fixed fee, data or licensing deals.
  • Working knowledge of the affiliate and performance ecosystem and how publishers monetise content, for example Awin, Skimlinks, Rakuten, Partnerize, Impact or similar.
  • Experience selling or landing something new, a product, model or proposition without an established category, rather than managing an existing book of business.
  • Comfortable navigating multi-stakeholder deals spanning commercial, editorial, legal, privacy and technical teams.
  • International exposure across at least two of UK, US and DACH/EMEA markets.
  • Desirable: experience with content licensing, AI/LLM discovery, SEO/AEO, or data partnership deals.
  • Commercially creative, able to construct a value exchange where no price list exists.
  • Relationship builder with genuine credibility at senior level.
  • Strong negotiator, comfortable with ambiguity and long sales cycles.
  • Excellent storyteller: can turn technical capability into a publisher-relevant revenue narrative.
  • Confident, credible public speaker, comfortable on stage and in front of a room as a visible advocate for Awin’s strategy.
  • Self-starting and resilient. This is a build role, not a maintain role.
  • Collaborative and low-ego; comfortable pulling in engineering, legal, product and local market teams.
  • Analytically confident: fluent in performance data, able to interrogate reporting and defend a number.
  • Strategic mindset paired with a bias to action and closing.
  • Technically literate rather than technical: able to hold a credible conversation about tags, tracking, CDNs and edge/worker deployments, page performance and data flows, and to know when to bring engineering into the room.
  • Confident with analytics and reporting platforms, including GA4, publisher analytics, BI dashboards and Excel or Sheets.
  • Comfortable working with privacy and consent concepts, including GDPR and consent frameworks, as they affect publisher data sharing.
  • Fluent English essential. German or another European language advantageous.
  • Willingness to travel to relevant markets as required.

 

Our Offer

  • Flexi-Office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid working model, designed to foster collaboration, trust, and autonomy.

In addition, you’ll benefit from our global offering, including health and wellbeing initiatives, learning and development via Awin Academy, and peer-to-peer recognition programmes.

description: Where Europe's enterprises adopt AI Langdock is the AI platform used by more than 10,000 companies to give employees secure access to the leading AI models, to build and share agents and to automate repetitive workflows.
